data.title: Carport building permit rejected by Landratsamt Musterinn
data.summary: The Landratsamt Musterinn (Bauamt) rejected Kathrin Musterreiter's application to build a carport with an equipment room on plot Fl.-Nr. 88/14, because the site lies in the Inn's designated flood zone (Überschwemmungsgebiet) and the required exception conditions under § 78 Abs. 5 WHG are not met. A separate €120 fee notice for this rejection will follow, and a lawsuit against this decision may be filed with the Verwaltungsgericht Musterregensburg within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The building office refused the carport permit because the plot is in a legally protected flood zone, where new structures are only allowed in exceptional cases, and the authority found the carport would take away flood-retention space without compensation. No formal objection (Widerspruch) is possible here — only a direct lawsuit (Klage) at the administrative court. The app will show the deadline for this, computed from this letter's notification. A separate bill for the €120 processing fee will arrive later; no payment is due from this letter itself. Consider consulting a lawyer specializing in building/water law if you wish to challenge the decision or explore an alternative design that leaves retention space.
